subject.title: [Bug]: Catalog continuation can send a draft into the wrong conversation

question: Should the Control UI treat this as a P1 cross-conversation message-delivery regression and sponsor the bounded ownership-guard fix now?
rationale: The report is concrete and high-impact, but the `maintainer` label requires explicit maintainer handling before any automated repair lane can act.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded UI fix
options.body: Confirm the continuation completion path should ignore stale results unless its original connection, catalog/session generation, and send operation still own the active state.

options.title: Request a focused implementation PR
options.body: Keep the issue open while asking for a narrow patch and the four stated regression cases against current main.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded UI fix
recommendation.body: Confirm the continuation completion path should ignore stale results unless its original connection, catalog/session generation, and send operation still own the active state.
